Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ChatService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ChatService
public final class ChatService extends Object
The public seam for chat. Both the buyer and seller portals go through this service, so there is exactly one place that decides who may send and whether a thread accepts offers. Access control lives here, not in the UI and not in ChatStore.

  • Field Details

    • OFFERS_CLOSED_BANNER

      public static final String OFFERS_CLOSED_BANNER
      Shown on a thread whose Listing is no longer live, and used as the refusal message for a blocked Formal Offer. Plain messages are never blocked: buyer and seller keep talking through a reserved or lent deal and after it completes (SRS UC-1.5 only closes offers).
      See Also:

    • sendText

      public Message sendText(User sender, ChatThread thread, String content)
      Sends a free-text message. Only the thread's Buyer or the Listing's Seller may send. Messages stay open whatever the Listing's status, so the two can arrange a meet-up or return and follow up after the deal. Empty content is rejected.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if sender is not a participant of the thread
      IllegalArgumentException - if the content is blank

    • submitFormalOffer

      public Message submitFormalOffer(User sender, ChatThread thread, BigDecimal price)
      Submits a price offer on the thread's Sale Listing and posts it as one Formal Offer card. Only the thread's Buyer may offer, and only while the Listing is live.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if sender is not the thread's Buyer
      IllegalStateException - if the Listing is no longer live
      IllegalArgumentException - if the Listing is not for sale or the price is invalid

    • submitFormalOffer

      public Message submitFormalOffer(User sender, ChatThread thread, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Submits a borrow request on the thread's Lend Listing and posts it as one Formal Offer card. Only the thread's Buyer may request, and only while the Listing is live.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if sender is not the thread's Buyer
      IllegalStateException - if the Listing is no longer live
      IllegalArgumentException - if the Listing is not for lending or the period is invalid

    • submitFormalOffer

      public Message submitFormalOffer(User sender, ChatThread thread)
      Submits a claim on the thread's Giveaway Listing and posts it as one Formal Offer card. Only the thread's Buyer may claim, and only while the Listing is live.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if sender is not the thread's Buyer
      IllegalStateException - if the Listing is no longer live
      IllegalArgumentException - if the Listing is not a giveaway

    • acceptOffer

      public Deal acceptOffer(User seller, DealRequest request)
      Accepts request on behalf of the Listing's Seller. This is a thin wrapper: every transition, deal-creation and Listing-status change stays in DealLifecycle.accept(com.hkust.marketplace.models.DealRequest). The card is re-rendered from the request's live status, never from a local flag.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if seller is not the Seller of the request's Listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not pending

    • declineOffer

      public DealRequest declineOffer(User seller, DealRequest request)
      Declines request on behalf of the Listing's Seller. This is a thin wrapper: the status change and any Listing relist stay in DealLifecycle.decline(com.hkust.marketplace.models.DealRequest). The request and its card remain in the retained history.
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if seller is not the Seller of the request's Listing
      IllegalStateException - if the request is not pending or countered

    • search

      public List<Message> search(User user, String keyword, MessageSearchFilter filter)
      Searches the messages of every thread the user participates in. A Buyer sees only their own threads and a Seller only threads on their Listings, so search can never leak another user's private conversation.

      Matching is a case-insensitive substring test over Message.getContent(). A Formal Offer's content is its generated summary, so offers are found by their price, lending period or Listing title like any other text. filter selects the kinds: TEXT_ONLY drops offers, OFFERS_ONLY keeps only offers and ALL keeps both.

      A blank keyword returns everything only under OFFERS_ONLY, which doubles as an "all offers" listing. Under ALL and TEXT_ONLY a blank keyword returns nothing, so an accidental empty search cannot dump a user's whole history. Results are ordered newest-first.

      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if user or filter is null
